programs.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week
programs.desc: Robert Irwin comes face to face with a great white shark for the first time with shark conservationists Paul de Gelder and Madison Stewart  following in his father's footsteps, he will get as close as possible to these incredible creatures.

programs.title: The Zoo: A New Beginning
programs.desc: Max the Camel faces new challenges as he ages  the Zoo prepares to give an injured turkey vulture a permanent home, but after healing, there may be a change of plan  Willow the Red Panda gives birth to two baby cubs.

programs.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Survival of the Friendliest
programs.desc: A look at how dogs have evolved from wild predators to friendly pets  features parts of the world where dogs are spoiled as much as children.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Night Stalker
programs.desc: A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness  single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
programs.desc: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property  plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Cat Scratch Fever
programs.desc: Tom tries to reunite the not-so-sweet, Cake with its owners  Tom rescues a cat that will not let go of him in Burien.
